user_request: Add the thirteen PDF calculation functions and three condition comparisons while preserving the detailed 2D maps.
scope: Nineteen spatial measurements, persistent metric-independent object-footprint context, exact finer local rebinning and vector/8k/12k exports.
rationale: Round subdivisions of the original common extent, selected to expose resolution sensitivity and permit finer source-object review, without optimizing a condition effect.
signed_scale: Symmetric linear, centered at zero and shared across both arms within each resolution; limits may differ between resolutions.
display_saturation_policy: Beyond-range bins use endpoint colors and are counted explicitly; exact arrays and hover values remain uncapped. Full-range figures retained.
support_definition: Per-section bin has at least one exported PLA or ChAT object; observed support does not establish full tissue coverage.
point_display: All selected PLA bounding-box midpoints, filtered only by requested section and displayed review window; never original fluorescence pixels or cell centroids.
biological_sample_size: Three animals per condition; the same six animals occur in both PLA arms.
mean_denominator: Three for count/sum bins with valid attributes, including assumed empty-bin zeros; 0–3 defined section values for object means, quantiles and fractions.
default_signed_range_rationale: A labeled ±25 linear display exposes small count contrasts compressed by extreme bins. Saturated bin counts are explicit; uncapped values and full-range restore are retained.
mean_scale_policy: Shared linear range across both conditions and both arms; capped view discloses saturated bins and preserves exact values; full-range restore uses shared full maximum.
color_controls: Units-aware presets, full range and arbitrary positive display cap; never changes values.
added_static_detail_cap: 95th percentile of nonzero absolute comparison values, shared across arms; full-range companions retained.

context_geometry_policy.source: Finest original 100-unit union of bins containing PLA or ChAT detections across six sections, separately per arm
context_geometry_policy.fill: Pale detected-object footprint beneath selected finite measurement tiles

detail_resolution_policy.local_method: Rebin exact unsampled cached PLA coordinates and matching attributes; preserve whole-section totals and full-section nearest-neighbor distances

exports.svg: Independent vector tiles plus footprint and boundary paths, not a screenshot or embedded raster heatmap
exports.control_meaning: PNG downloads use a fixed width of 8000 pixels; no export-size selector. Spatial calculations and on-screen dimensions are unchanged.
exports.fine_detail_shortcut: Open fine detail scrolls to computed 100/50/25/10-unit bins without changing the selected statistic or bin width.
